_comment: The bench fleet. Each entry pairs a queue with the card authored for its
own imageable area and the blob captured after configuring it by hand.
All three have to travel together: a card authored for another device is
clipped or rescaled, and an unpinned job inherits whatever the driver UI
was last set to. See CLAUDE.MD, Verified 18, 43, 47 and 56.
targets is [horizontal, vertical] in mm, the two caliper distances the
card carries. It is recorded because the filename encodes only the page
size: regenerating without it silently re-authored the Epson card with a
50 mm vertical target in place of its 250 mm one, which is the most
sensitive scale check in the spike (Verified 42).
Read by the hub /demo route and by hub.ps1 cards. Paths are relative to
HUB_DIR and use forward slashes; Windows accepts them and JSON does not
